visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four women sit around a table with a striped tablecloth in a rustic room with white brick walls. They hold large wine glasses filled with a bright orange liquid and ice, moving them toward the camera. One woman wears a straw hat and white lace top. (2) The scene transitions to a boat ride where a mirror reflects the creator and her friend taking a smartphone selfie. The camera pans to show the exterior of a cafe labeled 'BAR CAFFETTERIA' on a canal with Venetian architecture under a cloudy sky. (3) A man in a black shirt stands at a green-roofed ticket kiosk. A hand holds up two rectangular, colorful paper tickets. Passers-by walk nearby on a stone-paved quay near a canal. (4) A wide shot shows a boat traveling down a narrow canal lined with aged buildings in Murano. The camera then moves inside a brightly lit gallery displaying intricate and colorful glass sculptures on white pedestals against brick walls. (5) On an outdoor street, two women in summer attire crouch down to pet a white and brown dog. The scene shifts to a canal in Burano with rows of brightly colored houses in shades of pink, yellow, and green. (6) A man and a woman walk and laugh together on a sidewalk in front of an orange building. The camera then enters a shop filled with white lace items, fans, and garments displayed on walls and hangers. (7) Inside the Libreria Acqua Alta bookstore, massive stacks of old books are piled against weathered stone walls. A calico cat sleeps on top of a book display. A television monitor displays historical footage of the shop flooded. (8) At dusk, the creator poses on the stone Rialto Bridge. Wide shots show the Grand Canal bustling with boats and gondolas. The video ends with a shot of the couple laughing in front of a turquoise building.
